scope: Error analysis of existing Svarah relay run. Baseline results/svarah_wer.json untouched. No ASR run except offline full-clip decode with the same Parakeet engine (svarah_offline_decode.py). Not ground-truth accuracy; no human listening performed.

policies.A: baseline wer.normalize: lowercase, curly apostrophes, hyphen->space, strip non [a-z0-9' ], no number mapping
policies.B: case+punctuation: already included in A (identical result); reported separately for completeness
policies.C: A + pre-pass on both sides (1,000->1000; 3.5->'3 point 5'; %->percent) + runs of >=2 single digits/digit-words -> one digit string + number-word runs -> integer
policies.D: C + join adjacent tokens x y -> xy when xy exists as a token on the other side (len>=4, not digits); symmetric
policies.E: SUPPLEMENTARY (not requested): D + remove filler tokens {uh um umm uhh uhm hmm hm mm mmm ah er erm eh huh} from both sides
